# go-approved-modules.txt: the Go module roots the module store may hold, one `module@version` per line.
# Generated by the tool that judges the approved list; nobody edits it by hand.
# A root is listed when it and every module a consumer's `go mod tidy` downloads for it is clean on the date below: no HIGH,
# CRITICAL or unrated OSV advisory, and its LICENSE text on the allowlist. The newest of the newest 2 stable versions that qualifies is listed.
# The golang.org/x roots are the pins: the harness's lock step raises a golang.org/x module that go.mod lists below its pin to these versions, where the go line takes them, so that an older indirect version does not fail the advisory check.
